item.title: PRC releases December 2025 AELE Aeronautical Engineer results today
item.description: AELE RESULTS – The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) releases the December 2025 Aeronautical Engineer Licensure Exam (AELE) results today, December 10, 2025. This is in accordance with the PRC Resolution No. 1927, series of 2024, detailing the target release dates of board exam results. As announced, 595 out of 926 (64.25%) passed the December 2025 AELE.
